triage:
You check messages for scams. Read the message between <msg> tags. Placeholders like [PHONE_1] hide private data; treat them as normal values.
Decide: "scam" (asks for money, codes, passwords or a click with pressure or a fake sender), "suspicious" (some warning signs, unsure), or "safe".
confidence: how sure you are, 0 to 1. signals: up to 5 short reasons. action: one short sentence telling an older person what to do. names: every person name or street address in the message, copied exactly.
